messages.author: user
messages.text: I want to get fitter and have more stamina. What weekly gym routine should I follow?

messages.author: model
messages.text:
Here is a 5-day endurance-focused plan:

Monday - 40 minutes steady-state cardio, zone 2
Tuesday - full-body circuit, light weights, high reps
Wednesday - intervals: 8 x 400m with 90 seconds recovery
Thursday - active recovery, mobility and a long walk
Friday - tempo run, 25 minutes at a comfortably hard pace
Weekend - one long easy session, build to 90 minutes

Keep about 80% of the volume easy. Most people ruin their endurance progress by running their easy days too hard.

messages.author: user
messages.text: Should I lift heavy as well?

messages.author: model
messages.text: Two short strength sessions per week is enough alongside this volume. Heavy lifting and high-volume endurance work compete for recovery, so if you want to prioritise stamina, keep the lifting to compound movements and low sets.

messages.author: user
messages.text: Do I need electrolyte drinks for an hour-long session?

messages.author: model
messages.text: For under 60 to 90 minutes in temperate conditions, water is fine. Electrolytes start to matter when you are sweating heavily, training in heat, or going beyond about 90 minutes.
